claim_text: Video captures NEET 2026 candidates sharing their joy after the results were declared on July 16, 2026.
ground_truth_notes: BOOM's official ClaimReview: Claimed By BJP, Fact Check: False. This specific Instagram Reel (posted by @pw_vidyapeeth_up on 2026-05-07) is one of the source videos BOOM traced and embedded directly in their article as recirculated to falsely suggest NEET 2026 result-day celebration; video predates the actual July 16 2026 result declaration.

claim_text: Video shows a woman's masked identity being revealed amid misconduct/indecency at the Delhi CJP protest at Jantar Mantar.
ground_truth_notes: Alt News traced this exact Reel (posted by Karni Sena leader Vishnu Rajput, 2026-07-26) via reverse image search to FIFA World Cup 2026 celebration footage from Mexico (originally posted by 'flowmexicanoofficial', 2026-06-27). Straightforward miscaptioned/wrong-context video -- FALSE, not MIXED.

claim_text: Video/image shows a real woman in a white saree genuinely present as a protester at the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) demonstrations at Jantar Mantar.
ground_truth_notes: BOOM found at least six different AI-generated women, all wearing the same outfit, whose faces had been grafted onto real protest footage -- confirmed synthetic using OpenAI's Verify tool. Distinct failure mode from item-0001/0002 (miscaptioned REAL footage): this is fully AI-generated/synthetic imagery, not repurposed genuine video. Article published 4 Aug 2026; embeds 4 Instagram URLs, this one (@divyankaha) verified live via TruthLensBot UA fetch (HTTP 200, og:description matches: '#Jantarmantarprotest #cjpprotest', 413K likes, posted 2026-07-24).

claim_text: Video shows a police baton fitted with nails, filmed at the July 20, 2026 Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) protest at Jantar Mantar, Delhi -- genuine footage from that protest, not fake/unrelated as Delhi Police and PIB claimed.
ground_truth_notes: Delhi Police and PIB publicly called this video fake/unrelated to the protest. BOOM verified authenticity via metadata (timestamp 16:33, July 20 2026) and GPS coordinates matching Gate No. 3, Janpath Metro Station -- confirmed shot by UPSC aspirant Upendra Gaur (@gaur_95_com). Caveat BOOM itself notes: authenticity/location confirmed, but footage alone does not establish who fitted the nails or that police used it -- claim_text here is scoped only to the confirmed part (authenticity + location + date), not the unconfirmed part. Rare TRUE-verdict item and the only one in this set where the ORIGINAL false claim came from a GOVERNMENT body (Delhi Police/PIB), not a political party or activist -- valuable for RQ5. Live-verified via TruthLensBot UA fetch (HTTP 200, og:description: '237K likes, 12K comments - gaur_95_com on July 20, 2026').

claim_text: Video/photo shows CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke meeting Jharkhand Congress president Keshav Mahto Kamlesh.
ground_truth_notes: Factly verdict: MISLEADING, not simple FALSE -- the person alongside Abhijeet Dipke IS a real Congress leader (Babajani Durrani, Maharashtra), just misidentified as a different, more prominent Congress leader (Jharkhand's Keshav Mahto Kamlesh) than he actually is. Factly confirmed via reverse image search that this is Babajani Durrani's own original Instagram post (his account, posted 4 Aug 2026, caption states he met Abhijeet Dipke in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Maharashtra). First non-binary-verdict item in this set (existing items are all FALSE/TRUE) and a genuinely different failure mode: person misidentification via name confusion between two real people who share a party affiliation, not miscaptioned event/AI fakery. Live-verified via TruthLensBot UA fetch (HTTP 200, og:image resolves to a real CDN asset matching og:url).

claim_text: Video shows real, devastating footage documenting the July 2026 Assam floods.
ground_truth_notes: BOOM Hindi confirmed this specific video (posted by comedy creator @simransk944 on 3 July 2026, captioned only with a laughing emoji, no flood claim in the original post at all) was later stripped of context and recirculated as real Assam flood footage. BOOM's own AI-detection tool (Hive Moderation) found the video 98.8% likely AI-generated. Deliberately NOT a political-actor claim -- closes a real gap in the first 5 items (all involved a named party/leader/government body); this is disaster misinformation with no partisan origin, matching the brief's explicit call for 'neutral' claims. Live-verified via TruthLensBot UA fetch (HTTP 200, og:description matches: 'simransk944 on July 3, 2026').

claim_text: A 5-second clip shows a speaker at the July 2026 CJP protest at Jantar Mantar raising Islamic slogans ('Naara-e-Taqbeer', 'Allahu Akbar'), implying communal/anti-national overtones to the protest.
ground_truth_notes: Shared by BJP leader Tajinder Bagga and supporters. Alt News's own verdict wording is 'FALSE' (per this project's annotation rule of using the org's own wording, not a softer read) though the underlying mechanism is selective cropping, not fabrication: the complete footage shows the same speaker first saying (in Hindi) 'Who says we Muslims don't chant Jai Shri Ram and Bharat Mata Ki Jai? We do, we are one' before mentioning the Islamic slogans -- a unity message, reversed in meaning by cutting the first half. First item in this set with genuinely Hindi spoken content (confirmed by Alt News's own article and the post's own Hinglish caption 'Aaj kiya bat boli h bhai ne'), closing a real gap the first 5 items had. Original poster @youtuber__sufiyan, 569K likes. Live-verified via TruthLensBot UA fetch (HTTP 200).
